The weighted cloud reliability calculator achieved a perfect reward score by successfully passing the legacy pytest suite without exceptions.
The run achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.83, with 0 exceptions across all trials. Pytest version 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.346s. While the logic is stable, future iterations should re-check the weighting assumptions to ensure the judge_reward aligns more closely with the perfect verifier score.
